plugins.name: Word Count
plugins.description: Words, characters and reading time for the open file, in the status bar.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: TODO Finder
plugins.description: Marks TODO, FIXME, HACK and XXX comments in the editor and the Problems panel.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Sort Lines
plugins.description: Sort, reverse, shuffle and de-duplicate lines in the selection or the whole file.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Case Converter
plugins.description: Rename a symbol into another case (F2 lists camelCase, snake_case, PascalCase, CONSTANT_CASE), or convert selected text to any case from the command palette.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Insert Date, UUID & More
plugins.description: Insert the date, time, a timestamp, a UUID or placeholder text at the cursor.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Emoji Completions
plugins.description: Type :smile in Markdown or plain text to pick from common emoji.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: JSON Tools
plugins.description: Format, minify, sort keys and validate JSON in the selection or the whole file, with errors marked where they are.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Encode / Decode
plugins.description: Base64, URL, HTML entity and JSON string encoding and decoding for the selection or the whole file.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Hash
plugins.description: SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 hashes of the selection or the whole file: replace the text with its hash, or copy any of them.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Text Transforms
plugins.description: Reverse, ROT13, slugify, trim, join, number and word-wrap the selection or the whole file.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Whitespace Linter
plugins.description: Marks trailing whitespace, indentation that mixes tabs and spaces, and a missing final newline as you type, with a command to fix them.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Number Tools
plugins.description: Convert numbers between decimal, hex, binary and octal, increment or decrement them with a shortcut, add thousands separators, and see any number literal in every base on hover.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Timestamps
plugins.description: Hover a Unix timestamp to see its date in UTC and your time zone, convert between timestamps and ISO dates, and insert the current time.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Color Tools
plugins.description: Hover a CSS color to see it as hex, rgb() and hsl(), convert colors between those formats, and lighten or darken them.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Markdown TOC
plugins.description: Insert a table of contents built from your Markdown headings, with GitHub-style links, and keep it up to date when you save.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Markdown Table
plugins.description: Format Markdown tables (aligned pipes, padded cells, :---: alignment), turn CSV into a table, and add rows and columns.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Markdown Lint
plugins.description: Flags common Markdown problems as you type: skipped heading levels, trailing spaces, extra blank lines, images without alt text, mixed list markers and missing blank lines.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: CSV Tools
plugins.description: Convert CSV to JSON and JSON to CSV, and align CSV columns for reading. Detects comma, semicolon and tab separators and handles quoted fields.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: SQL Formatter
plugins.description: Formats SQL: uppercase keywords, each clause on its own line, one select item per line, AND/OR indented. Works with Format Document.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: License Header
plugins.description: Insert an SPDX license header (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause, GPL-3.0-or-later, MPL-2.0) in the right comment style, or create a LICENSE file.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: React Snippets
plugins.description: Snippets for React components and hooks: rfc, rafce, useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo, useCallback, useContext, createContext and more.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Python Snippets
plugins.description: Snippets for common Python code: main guard, dataclass, class, def with docstring, try/except, with open, comprehensions, argparse, pytest, logging and NamedTuple.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Clock
plugins.description: The time in the status bar. Click it to switch between 12-hour and 24-hour time; hover for the full date.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Pomodoro
plugins.description: A focus timer in the status bar: 25-minute focus sessions and 5-minute breaks, with a count of today's completed sessions.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Selection Stats
plugins.description: Characters, words and lines of the selection, in the status bar.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: File Info
plugins.description: The open file's size, line count and line endings in the status bar, with its longest line and indentation on hover.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Quote & Bracket Toggler
plugins.description: Cycle the string at the cursor between single, double and backtick quotes, and wrap the selection in brackets, quotes or Markdown emphasis.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Gitignore Generator
plugins.description: Add a .gitignore template (Node, Python, Rust, Go, Java, C/C++, macOS, Windows, Linux, VS Code, JetBrains) without duplicating lines already there.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Bookmarks
plugins.description: Bookmark lines, jump between them in a file, and list every bookmark across your files.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Regex Search
plugins.description: Search the open file with a regular expression and jump to any match from a list.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Word Frequency
plugins.description: The 50 most frequent words in the file or selection, with counts. Choose one to copy it.
plugins.author: Sable

plugins.name: Search the Web
plugins.description: Search Google, DuckDuckGo, Stack Overflow, MDN, docs.rs, PyPI or npm for the selection or the word at the cursor.
plugins.author: Sable
